content.value: Given $c x - y + 2 z = 0 , 2 x + 2 y + 3 z = 0 , x - 3 y + 2 z = 0 ,$ then determine the (17) [CO4] value of $\cdot _ { \mathbf { c } } \cdot$ for which the given system of linear equations has i) a trivial solution and ii) non-trivial solutions. If non trivial solutions exist, find the corresponding solution by selecting an appropriate numerical value for $\bullet _ { \mathbf { c } } \bullet $ . Find nullity and basis of the null space. Express this solution space in vector parametric form and illustrate the solution space through drawing.
